original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯BRT与小型巴士相撞致五人受伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州Asolo BRT走廊发生一起小型快速公交与商业小型巴士迎面相撞事故，造成至少五人不同程度受伤。拉各斯州交通管理局称，伤者已被疏散并送往最近医院救治。该消息目前仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Asolo BRT corridor in Lagos State

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州Asolo BRT走廊发生小型快速公交与商业小型巴士迎面相撞事故
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a head-on collision between a mini Rapid Transit bus and a commercial minibus, popularly known as Korope, along the Asolo BRT corridor in Lagos State

key_facts.fact: 事故造成至少五人不同程度受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: No fewer than five people have sustained varying degrees of injuries

key_facts.fact: 伤者已被疏散并送往最近医院救治
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the victims were evacuated and taken to the hospital for medical attention

key_facts.fact: 消息由拉各斯州交通管理局在其X页面发布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Lagos State Traffic Management Authority disclosed this in a post on its X page on Tuesday

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
伤者具体人数与伤情程度尚未获独立确认
